messages:
maria: Heads-up: after yesterday's KMS rotation we started seeing SAML assertion failures from the federation proxy. SCIM pushes are 502/invalid_assertion. Anyone looking into KMS context issues? :eyes:
aj: I can grab logs. Which proxy cluster/region?
maria: prod-eu cluster-3. Error in proxy log looks like JWE decrypt failed + 'encryption context mismatch'. Paste below.
maria: ```
2026-03-19T22:04:12Z proxy[svc]: WARN failed to decrypt assertion: jwe_decrypt_error: JWE_DECRYPTION_FAILED (context mismatch)
2026-03-19T22:04:12Z scim-sync[worker]: ERROR outbound request failed 502 invalid_assertion
2026-03-19T22:04:12Z kms-client: WARN decrypt failed, expected context {"sp_id":"redwood-proxy-prod-eu"} got {"alias":"kms/proxy-rotate-2026"}
```
nima: That KMS log line is the smoking gun — the encryption context used to encrypt the assertion token changed during rotation. Proxy expects the original context for local decrypt. Did the rotation create a new key without preserving context tags?
leah: Confirmed: rotation script re-keyed to alias `kms/proxy-rotate-2026` and key policy created a different encryption context variable. We didn't include `sp_id` in the new context.
aj: Can we re-encrypt recent tokens or roll back to the previous key quickly? Ops?
ops-oncall: Checking whether the old key material is still enabled. Running: `aws kms list-keys --region eu-west-1 --query 'Keys[?contains(KeyId, `proxy`)]'` — will report back.
sec-bot: INCIDENT 2026-03-19-1023 opened (severity: medium). Affected: SSO federation -> SCIM provisioning. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/idp-kms-rotation.
ops-oncall: Old key is in schedule-disabled state but still available for decrypts (key-id: abc-123-proxy-old). We can re-enable for 1h.
maria: If we re-enable old key, does that match the context? The log shows expected context `{"sp_id":"redwood-proxy-prod-eu"}`.
leah: Old key was created with context containing `sp_id`. New alias forgot it. Re-enabling old key should restore decryption for in-flight assertions. Will re-enable now and restart proxy gracefully.
leah: `aws kms enable-key --key-id abc-123-proxy-old`
aj: After re-enable, we should restart just the proxy worker that performs assertion decryption to clear any cached key context. Command: `kubectl -n idp rollout restart deploy/federation-proxy --context=prod-eu`
ops-oncall: Done: old key enabled. Rolling restart started. Watch logs.
aj: Logs show assertions decrypting again. SCIM syncs started to succeed (200 OK). :thumbsup:
maria: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) add a post-rotate validation that compares KMS encryption contexts (ensure `sp_id` preserved), 2) add a smoke test for SCIM pushes after key rotations.
nima: Also recommend tagging rotation automation to include `sp_id` in encryption context and add alert if context mismatch occurs.
sec-bot: Audit: wrote event to audit-log-service: `kms.rotation.reverted` and `saml.assertion.decrypt.failure` (count: 42).
maria: I'll file a short postmortem and update runbook with the exact `aws kms` steps and the kube restart snippet. Thanks everyone. Closing the incident after follow-up tasks. :heavy_check_mark:
ops-oncall: leaving a note in pagerduty: incident resolved, follow-ups created.
leah: I'll open a PR to rotation script to preserve encryption context and add unit tests.
aj: Great. If anyone wants, I can schedule a 10min sync to go over the root cause and add to oncall checklist.
maria: Done — invite sent for 10:30.
